title: Japanese Orange Bread Pudding
description: A sweet Japanese-inspired twist on traditional bread pudding, featuring orange zest for added citrus flavor.

ingredients.name: Bread
ingredients.amount: 4 cups stale bread, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, sugar, and orange zest.
Add bread cubes to the bowl and toss until bread is evenly coated.
Add orange segments to the bowl and toss until well combined.
Pour mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
